messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
I had hardly closed my eyes when I awoke to the sound of rain banging on the roof and the sound of my alarm going off at 7:30 am.

output.original_text: I had hardly closed my eyes when I awoke to the sound of rain banging on the roof and the sound of my alarm going off at 7:30 am.
output.joy: I had just closed my eyes when I woke up to the cheerful sound of rain tapping on the roof and my alarm joyfully ringing at 7:30 am!
output.sadness: I had barely closed my eyes when I was jolted awake by the relentless rain pounding on the roof and my alarm ringing at 7:30 am, a reminder of another gloomy day.
output.fear: I had just closed my eyes when I was suddenly startled awake by the thunderous rain crashing on the roof and my alarm blaring at 7:30 am, making my heart race.
output.anger: I had hardly closed my eyes when I was rudely awakened by the incessant rain slamming against the roof and my alarm shrieking at 7:30 am, completely ruining my sleep.
output.surprise: I had just closed my eyes when I was unexpectedly jolted awake by the loud rain clattering on the roof and my alarm going off sharply at 7:30 am!
output.disgust: I had barely shut my eyes when I was unpleasantly woken by the continuous rain pounding on the roof and my alarm blaring at 7:30 am—it was just gross.
